read_protocol.metadata_first: Use file_info on the exact known path; bind each subsequent binary read to its returned version. A missing file remains absent evidence.
read_protocol.full_small_files: Read complete bounded originals using actual returned size; preserve raw bytes, length, SHA256 and metadata/version.
read_protocol.large_logs: Read bounded relevant stderr/stdout tail or actual failure span first. Do not claim a full log hash without complete bytes or an authoritative pinned capture.

ordered_decisions.authoritative_process_record: The actual unique build07 job durable status, final stdout/stderr, exit code, timeout/cancel/retry and log completeness must be settled first. A transport deadline or tool error is not a build result.

ordered_decisions.purpose: Determine inner_build_called, pre/post snapshot state, child/root supervisor captures and FD/pidfd/descendant/subreaper/watchdog cleanup. Read failed root capture paths only as named by actual terminal/source; no guessed PID namespace access.

ordered_decisions.condition: Only where actual outer terminal records the relevant phase as entered
ordered_decisions.purpose: Bind pre/post explicit47/runtime/role facts and actual lifecycle controls to the exact request. Explicit47 remains an explicit set, not a fresh complete launcher resolver.

ordered_decisions.condition: Only if inner was actually invoked; absence at a precondition failure is expected
ordered_decisions.purpose: Resolve fresh resource admission, prepared builder/source inputs, actual child command start, return code and immutable-input verification. inner_build_called alone does not prove the Soong command ran.

ordered_decisions.condition: Read only logs that actually exist; use actual sizes and original paths
ordered_decisions.purpose: Identify actual failure stage, first substantive Soong/compiler error and relevant context. Do not expand dependency closure speculatively.

ordered_decisions.condition: After actual builder entry, regardless of success, before proposing a successor
ordered_decisions.purpose: Determine actual published source-lock state. build06 never entered the builder; build07 may publish the new 242-project source before a later error. Never assume the old225 or new242 state without the actual record.

ordered_decisions.condition: After actual normal command success and existing completion gate
ordered_decisions.purpose: Verify the exact Strict framework-minus-apex/libandroid_runtime invocation, projected Java/JNI input paths and successful restoration. Inputs/attempt receipts alone do not prove compilation; command success remains distinct from artifact qualification/deployment.

two_target_artifact_followup.artifact_paths: Obtain from the actual successful Ninja build/link graph and variant/output records; no framework JAR or libandroid_runtime.so output path is guessed here.
framework-minus-apex: Identify the actual implementation JAR variant, not a turbine/header/stub JAR.
Verify actual compiled Zygote, ZygoteArguments and ZygoteConnection class entries/implementation code against the expected source changes. Bind to source-lock/build-command/input receipts.
libandroid_runtime: Identify the Android-target variant and actual com_android_internal_os_Zygote.cpp compilation command/depfile, then its contribution to the final link.
Verify complete output bytes, SHA, target ABI and Android build provenance. ELF64 or a successful host library build alone is insufficient.
not_established_by_command_success: artifact-level Java and JNI pair qualification
